stem: The total length of National Highways in Bihar is:

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: According to the Bihar Economic Survey, 2015–16, the length of National Highways in Bihar increased from 3410 km. in 2001 to 4595 km in 2015. As per the Bihar Economic Survey, 2024–25 (status as of September, 2024), the total length of National Highways in Bihar is 6130 km, while according to the Annual Report, 2024–25 issued by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Government of India, the length of National Highways in Bihar was 6132 km as of 31 December, 2024.

stem: The road length per lakh of population in Bihar is

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: According to the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, as on 31 March, 2019, in National Highways (per lakh population), Bihar’s road length ranks fifth from the bottom.

stem: Which of the following National Highways connects Chhapra and Gopalganj?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: At the time of the question, National Highway No. 85 connected Chhapra–Siwan–Gopalganj, whereas National Highway 77 connected Hajipur–Sitamarhi–Sonbarsa, National Highway 84 connected Ara–Buxar, and National Highway 80 connected Mokama–Rajmahal–Farakka.

stem:
Match List-I (Characteristics of National Highways) with List-II (Numbers of National Highways) and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists:
List-I List-II (Characteristics of (Numbers of National Highways) National Highways)
A. National Highway that 1. National Highway passes through Bihar No. 12
B. National Highway that 2. National Highway does not pass through No. 87 Bihar
C. National Highway having 3. National Highway maximum length in Bihar No. 2
D. Proposed National 4. National Highway Highway not to serve No. 31 Bihar.
Codes : A B C D
expl: At the time of the question, the main stretch of National Highway No. 87 connected Rampur (Uttar Pradesh) to Jeolikote (Uttarakhand) and National Highway No. 12 connected Jabalpur (Madhya Pradesh) to Jaipur (Rajasthan)— these did not pass through Bihar. National Highway No. 2 also passed through Bihar, but its length was 202 km, whereas at present, the longest National Highway passing through Bihar is National Highway No. 27 (East–West/E.W.), whose length is 487 km.

stem: Which one is not located on National Highway-2 (NH-2)?
expl: At the time of the question, under National Highway-2 (NH- 2), Bihar included Mohania, Sasaram, Aurangabad and Dehri-on-Sone, whereas NH-2 did not pass through Patna

stem: The National Highway that passes through Bihar is
expl: National Highway No. 23 connected Chas of the then undivided Bihar with Ranchi, Gumla and Thethaitangar. According to the Annual Report, 2024–25 issued by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, as on 31 December, 2024, the total number of National Highways passing through Bihar is 56, and their total length in Bihar is 6132 km. The length of National Highway No. 27 (East– West/E.W.) in Bihar is 487 km.

stem: The East Central Railway zone headquarters is located at-
expl: The headquarters of the East Central Railway zone is located at Hajipur. It includes the Sonpur, Samastipur, Danapur, Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyaya and Dhanbad divisions.

stem: The most powerful locomotive of India, manufactured at Madhepura Locomotive Factory. The power of the electric rail engine is-

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The power of India’s most powerful electric locomotive manufactured at the Madhepura Electric Locomotive Factory is 12,000 horsepower (HP).

stem: Which of the following global companies bagged the contract for setting up of locomotive factories in Bihar?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The global company GE (United States) and the French company Alstom were awarded the contract to establish locomotive factories in Bihar. GE set up its factory at Marhaura in Saran district, while Alstom established its factory at Madhepura.
